meaning: One new focused complete C++ arithmetic closure ABI comparison against original generated scalar helpers: whole scratch-bank words, inactive lanes, mixed masks, a/b/d aliasing, exact identities/signed zeros/subnormals/nonfinite/refusal boundaries. Scalar agreement is supporting finite compatibility, not independent math proof, full-program or performance acceptance.
